licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung lines and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker (clean). Secco recitative, printed without a key signature; it ends at the double bar marked Attacca l'Aria, before No. 8. The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 83, from the median length (0:46) of five complete recordings, which give this recitative a track of its own (Fricsay 1958 0:41, Giulini 1959 0:36, Böhm 1977 0:46, Haitink 1984 0:48, Karajan 1985 0:47). Schirmer prints Recit. only.
